question: Acceptance Criteria 4 and the live halves of 2 and 5 need two actions no agent can take here: pasting the real Sapience token into secrets/secrets.yaml via sops, and running sudo nixos-rebuild switch (sudo is structurally denied in this harness). How should the implementation close?
answer: Run the Phase 6 operator sequence yourself when the implementation reaches it, so all six acceptance criteria get live evidence
obligation: Acceptance Criterion 4's loginctl show-user benjamin --property=Linger reporting Linger=yes after a system switch, plus AC2's prompt-free sapience-bootstrap against a real /run/secrets/sapience_token and AC5's no-op second nixos-rebuild switch.
